author: Kevin Kelly
short: Saved bot status profiles, message rotation, weekly schedules and music presence.
description: Owner-only global bot presence with named persistent profiles, five Discord activity types, availability, rotating messages, timezone-aware weekly schedules, safe dynamic placeholders and an optional selected-server AudioPlus listening override. Rate-limited gateway updates, reconnect refresh, read-only previews and owned worker cleanup. All controls support prefix and slash commands. Independently installable; no additional dependencies.
install_msg: Read https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/presenceplus/README.md. Automation defaults off. Use [p]presence set custom Use !help for commands, [p]presence add watching {servers} servers and [p]presence interval 300. All controls require bot ownership; presence is global across servers. Update/reload AudioPlus before using [p]presence music true in your chosen music server. Enable slash controls with [p]slash enablecog presenceplus and [p]slash sync.
end_user_data_statement: Stores bot-owner configured global status profiles, availability, rotation interval, timezone, weekly schedules and an optional AudioPlus source server ID and music template in Red Config. Profiles and templates store the text the owner supplies; do not include private personal information. No member-specific records, listening histories or tokens are collected. Dynamic member counts and the selected server's current song/listener count are read from memory and not persisted. Enabled status text is sent to Discord and is visible across the bot's servers. Runtime rotation, previous presence and safe error types are transient and clear on unload. User-data hooks return no per-user data; the bot owner can clear all saved settings using presence reset true.
